about_the_game:
This is a management simulation game featuring Chinese ancient-style architectural layouts. Players own an establishment similar to an inn or shop, with areas such as main halls and sales departments. Within this venue, players can engage in operational management.

Resource Management

The top of the screen displays the quantities of gold coins and diamonds. Players can manage these resources for shop operations, building upgrades, and other purposes.

Building and Area Management

There are functional building areas such as "Main Hall" and "General Goods Stall". Players need to construct, upgrade, and furnish these areas to enhance the venue's operational efficiency and revenue.

Task System

A "Tasks" button located at the bottom allows players to obtain rewards by completing missions, thereby advancing the game's progression.

Construction Function

The game also includes a construction feature, enabling players to build new structures or facilities within the scene to expand their business scale.

Character Exploration Function

An exploration function may allow players to leave the venue for activities such as exploration, trading, and accepting external missions. An "Achievements" button lets players view their in-game accomplishments.
